svg.title: Sequence Diagram
svg.desc: This sequence follows a successful new receiving request through the UI, Express inventory handler and Sequelize/MySQL persistence. The related receipt, batches, balance changes, movements and operation result commit together.
svg.text: UML sequence | POST /api/inventory/receive, successful new request
7. create operation; lock items; create receipt
8. each line: validate, convert; create batch
Alternative: identical request returns stored result; changed identity → 409; any transactional exception → rollback.
